name: Italian-Style Mason Jar "Grinder Salad" with Mixed Deli Meats, Cheese & Pepperoncini (Prep-Ahead)

instructions.primary_message: Place mayo, vinegar, oil, and spices in a small bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing and divide between two (quart-size) jars.
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ cup mayonnaise
1 ½ tbsp white wine vinegar
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
½ tsp Italian seasoning
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper
¼ tsp garlic powder
¼ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Peel, halve, and small dice onion. Add to the jars with the dressing.
Drain and roughly chop pepperoncini into smaller pieces. Add to the jars.
Wash, dry, and small dice tomatoes. Add to the jars along with the cheese.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 cup shredded cheese, mozzarella & provolone blend

instructions.primary_message: Stack meat slices one on top of another, then medium dice. Add to the jars.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 oz Italian dry salami, sliced (salame)
3 oz deli ham, sliced
3 oz oven roasted turkey breast, sliced

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry lettuce; halve lengthwise, cut out the core, and roughly chop into small pieces. Add to the jars, packing lightly if necessary.
Screw lids onto jars and store in the fridge until needed. (Best if used within 2-3 days.)
When ready to eat, empty jar into a bowl (making sure to scrape out all of the dressing!) and toss to combine the salad. Enjoy!
